U.S. Energy Information Administration (2023). Updated Buildings Sector Appliance and Equipment Costs and Efficiencies, March 2023. Appendixes A-D: Guidehouse and Leidos, EIA - Technology Forecast Updates - Residential and Commercial Building Technologies (Reference and Advanced Cases), prepared for EIA.

Region: United States. Loaded only commercial equipment that matches the industrial space-conditioning archetypes, 2022 columns of the Appendix A Reference case: gas warm-air furnace (space-heater_fuel-fired), electric resistance heaters (small and large), rooftop and ground-source heat pumps (heat-pump_space, typical and high), water-cooled centrifugal chillers (typical to chiller_vapour-compression, high to chiller_high-efficiency), air-cooled screw chillers (chiller_vapour-compression) and direct-fired gas absorption chillers (chiller_absorption). Costs are total installed (2022 USD), converted from per kBtu/h or per ton to per kW (0.29307 kW per kBtu/h; 3.51685 kW per ton). Efficiencies: heating COP or full-load cooling COP as %, furnace thermal efficiency on the US HHV basis. Lighting (added 2026-10-14, Appendix C commercial tables): mercury vapour, metal halide and high-pressure sodium high bay (lighting_hid), T5 HO high bay (lighting_fluorescent-high-bay), LED high-bay luminaire (lighting_led-high-bay), 4-ft T8 two-lamp systems (lighting_fluorescent-t8) and 4-ft LED luminaires (lighting_led): system efficacy (lm/W), total installed cost and maintenance per klm, lamp or luminaire life in hours and operating hours, for the 2012 or 2018 installed stock and the 2022 typical (and high) columns. EIA's system lumens for lamp-and-ballast systems are lamp lumens x ballast factor (no fixture losses) while LED figures are luminaire lumens, so the comparison flatters the conventional types. In _other-values: the occupancy-sensor case (hours 2,920 -> 1,869, +34 USD per klm) and commercial boilers (space-heating hot-water scale, not mapped). Not loaded: residential equipment, water heaters, cooking, refrigeration, ventilation, rooftop air conditioners, projections to 2050 and the Advanced case (Appendixes B and D). Locator: page numbers printed in each appendix (Appendix A pages 109-145).
